choices: Hides the window but keeps the JVM running
Exits the JVM when the window's close button is clicked
Asks the user to confirm before closing
Disposes of the window but continues running
explanation: EXIT_ON_CLOSE calls System.exit(0) when the close button is clicked, stopping the JVM. DISPOSE_ON_CLOSE just disposes the window. HIDE_ON_CLOSE hides it. If you omit this, clicking close only hides the window and the JVM keeps running.
